examples.arabic: انا بخير شكرا نحن نجهز لحفلة الزفاف
examples.english: I am fine thank you we are preparing for the wedding party
examples.transliteration: Ana bi khayr shukran nahnu nujahhiz li haflat az zafaf

examples.arabic: اليوم نريد ان نخطط لحفل الزفاف
examples.english: Today we want to plan the wedding party.
examples.transliteration: Al-yawm nureed an nukhattita lihafl az-zafaf

examples.arabic: ثم سالني فجاة عن خططي لحضور حفل زفاف ابن اخي الاسبوع القادم
examples.english: Then he suddenly asked me about my plans to attend my nephew's wedding next week.
examples.transliteration: Thumma sa'alanī faj'atan ʿan khuṭaṭī li-ḥuḍūr ḥafl zifāf ibn akhī al-usbūʿ al-qādim.
